reviews.title: Horrible Customer Support
reviews.text:
I will give credit in the fact that at a baseline this product is great. However, if any technical issue should arise, expect minimal competence from almost everyone you speak to. 

I have had two technical issues in the last 6 months. The initial  was told there was no fix but eventually I got to the right person and there was a solution. After weeks of this can’t be done. 

Now here we are with another technical issue and every level of trouble shooting, each person I’ve spoke to at this point, have zero solutions for a technical/admin focus area. 

This is what happens when billion dollar organizations higher out their technical experts to personnel who follow a basic playbook. 

I would never recommend this product to a business or person. There are plenty of other products that are better priced and offer the same outcome.

reviews.title: Poor AI makes the product worse
reviews.text: I’ve used Docusign many times to electronically verify signatures. Their unnecessary and unwanted “AI assisted” mode made many suggestions which were actively harmful.

reviews.title: Seems like a terrible app
reviews.text: Maybe it’s just me, but this app seems unmanageable. I’m not sure why everyone else loves it so much. Maybe the desktop version or website is a lot more efficient and intuitive, but the app is absolutely not. There’s nothing intuitive about the iOS version of DocuSign, and it seems glitchy on top of that. How a platform with a modular interface can actually function decently with no undo button or maneuverable capabilities is beyond me. And I really don’t get why others are able to use it so well. Again, maybe it’s just me who’s falling short, but right now it definitely doesn’t seem that way.

reviews.title: Deliverability is broken. Do not build on this.
reviews.text:
I sent contracts through Docusign and they never arrived. Not in spam. Not in quarantine. Gateway-rejected before delivery. Same story on the receiving side - envelopes from other companies never reach my inbox at all.

This is not an isolated glitch. Docusign’s own infrastructure is being systematically abused for phishing (ESET measured a 250% increase in Docusign phishing detections in late 2025), and Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and iCloud have responded by hard-filtering docusign.net at the mail gateway. Docusign’s official answer on their own community forum is to tell senders to ask their recipients’ IT teams to whitelist the domain. That is not a product. That is a support ticket shipped as a service.

For a platform whose entire value proposition is “your contract gets signed,” silent delivery failure is catastrophic. 

Every envelope you send is Schrödinger’s contract until someone tells you they never received it - and most recipients will never tell you, because they don’t know the envelope was ever sent.

The 4.8 star average here does not reflect the current state of the service. Anyone evaluating Docusign in 2026 should read their own community forums first and weight the mounting silent-failure reports accordingly.

I’m off the platform today.

reviews.title: Accessibility issues
reviews.text:
As a blind user of the VoiceOver screen reader for iOS, I must report that this app is not very accessible. I am unable to fill out and sign online documents electronically and I am unable to fill out and signed PDF documents. as the need to sign documents electronically becomes more common, this is a major issue for those of us who are Blind.

Currently, VoiceOver gives very little feedback when navigating the Docusign app on iOS. in order for it to become more accessible, DocuSign must allow users to locate form fields and text fields and access them. VoiceOver users need constant feedback when navigating an app. thank you in advance for your consideration.
